blind.description: A cluster of mineral dripstone formations / stalagmites rising from a common base. It consists of three tapered conical spires of varying heights—one tall central-rear spire, an intermediate spire, and a small front spire—each formed by tiered, rounded melting/dripping shelves with vertical fluting. The surface is smooth, solid, and continuous with no holes, hovering parts, or floating shards. Colored in earthy tones of warm tan, light caramel, and darker reddish-brown rock shading with subtle specular sheen, resembling wet cavern limestone/flowstone.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as an irregular circular/clover-shaped cluster of three concentric rounded peaks nestled together, surrounded by a ruffled, lobed bottom perimeter.
blind.height_vs_figure: About two-thirds the height of the figure (around 3.5 to 4 ft tall) and roughly 2.5 ft in diameter at the base.
